_README: Labelled from source (shape of spring-petclinic's ValidatorTests, found in the M6.14 re-grade). The test's validator is jakarta.validation.Validator; PetValidator implements Spring's org.springframework.validation.Validator — a different interface with the same short name. validator.validate(pet) is a library call and must never reach PetValidator.validate.

hard_case.catalog: Interface implementations matched by short name
